يستمعون (form VIII)
# يَسْتَمِعُونَ (yastamiʕūna) /jas.ta.mi.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# يُسْتَمَعُونَ (yustamaʕūna) /jus.ta.ma.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
